definitions.explanation: A sense of confidence in one's own abilities, achievements, or qualities. Carries a positive connotation of justified pride rather than arrogance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自負|じふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I take pride in my work.

examples.japanese: {日本一|にほんいち}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{自負|じふ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm confident that we are the best in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{自負|じふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えていた→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: The pride in his many years of experience sustained him.

notes:
Expresses a confident belief in one's own worth or ability. Unlike ⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧ (boasting), {自負|じふ} implies a quieter, more internalized sense of confidence. The verb form {自負|じふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to pride oneself on" or "to be confident that."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自負|じふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pride oneself on; to be confident
- {自負|じふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have pride/confidence
- {自負|じふ}{心|しん}: self-esteem; pride

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧: boasting; pride — more outwardly expressed, can be positive or negative
- ⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧: pride; honor — broader, can be pride in others or one's group
- ⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧: self-confidence — focuses on believing in one's ability to succeed
